ChangeLog: V8.2 Changelog * Added Auto Farm Casual Wins in Auto page, Special Modes section, you can go to sleep and farm +1k casual wins with your 2nd account, your 2nd account should be a lvl 1 slot for maximum speed. * Added support for Dragon Tickets in Auto Raid and Auto Dungeon, added Spend Dragon Tickets, Ticket Target and Ticket Reserve UI elements, the selected raid/dungeon to spend tickets on will be the last one to be completed on purpose. * Added Targeting Mode dropdown in Auto page, Targeting section, Lowest Distance (default) and Lowest Health modes. * Added Add To Auto Transform Dropdown setting to Auto Buy Moves. * Added Zenni Reserve slider setting to Auto Buy Beans and Auto Buy Moves. * FPS Cap is now a toggle and added Only When Unfocused setting. ------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Added Auto Execute toggle in Settings page to all scripts, autoexec folder of the executor is still more reliable. * All scripts UI size for PC are now 6% wider and 7% taller.
